pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Brown wire. Accepts 5 to 24 V: use VIN

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Yellow wire. On the -V version its HIGH level is the supply (5 V): use a voltage divider

pins.name: MODE
pins.notes: Black wire. Selects whether OUT is HIGH or LOW with liquid; see the seller sheet

sources.title: XKC-Y25 seller datasheet
sources.section: Supply 5 to 24 V; brown +V, yellow OUT, blue GND, black mode; senses through a non-metal wall up to 20 mm

sources.title: XKC-Y25 seller datasheet
sources.section: Versions: -V (voltage out), -NPN, -PNP; check which one you have
